title: Shuttle Conveyor
model_title: Reversible Shuttle Conveyor on a Travelling Carriage

introduction.definition: A shuttle conveyor is a short, reversible belt conveyor mounted on a travelling carriage. Material falls onto it from a fixed feed chute. By running the belt one way or the other and moving the carriage, it can discharge from either end along a row of bins, so one feed point can fill many bins on both sides.
applications: Bin and silo filling where a tripper would be too long
key_points: Interlocks prevent discharge with no bin below
introduction.summary: A shuttle conveyor is a short reversible belt conveyor on a travelling carriage. By running the belt in either direction and moving the carriage, it distributes material from a fixed feed point into many bins on both sides.

foundation: Support the conveyor stringers and drive frames on steelwork or plinths designed for belt tension, material load and drive torque.
alignment: Survey the structure so all pulleys and idlers are square to the centre line; train the belt empty, then loaded.
piping: Chutes designed for the material trajectory to centre-load the belt; skirts and dust seals at loading points; belt cleaners and plough at the discharge.
commissioning: Check pull-wire emergency stops, belt-drift and speed switches; run empty and loaded; record take-up position and motor current.

routine.task: Check belt tracking in both directions.

lubrication: Gearboxes: oil to grade and change interval; open gears and slew bearing: grease to schedule.
Wheels and pulley bearings: grease to schedule.

safety: Travel limit switches and end stops; level interlocks; guarding.

video_tutorials.title: Shuttle Conveyor — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Shuttle Conveyor.
A shuttle conveyor is a short, reversible belt conveyor mounted on a travelling carriage.
Material falls onto it from a fixed feed chute.
By running the belt one way or the other and moving the carriage, it can discharge from either end along a row of bins, so one feed point can fill many bins on both sides.
Typical applications include bin and silo filling where a tripper would be too long; coal and coke bunker distribution; grain and fertiliser storage.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Shuttle Conveyor works.
Material falls from the fixed feed chute onto the belt.
The belt runs towards the end above the bin being filled.
The carriage travels so the discharging end moves along the bins.
The belt reverses to fill the bins on the other side.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

video_tutorials.title: Shuttle Conveyor — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Shuttle Conveyor.
Check belt tracking in both directions.
Check carriage wheels and rails.
Replace belt, pulleys and bearings.
Watch for mistracking after reversal: belt runs off. Common cause: directional training idlers, misalignment.
Watch for overfill of a bin: spillage. Common cause: failed level sensor/interlock.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
